a.lede: As Jensen Huang returns to his post as Nvidia's CEO with support from the Trump administration, the Department of Commerce has added Megaspeed to its Entity List, which blocks trade with the company, citing national security risks. As reported earlier by Semafor, Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick had faced increasing pressure to list the company after […]
a.title: US Commerce Department adds Megaspeed to trade blacklist as Huang retakes control of Nvidia

b.lede: Megaspeed, which was previously led by Alice Huang, would be barred from doing business with U.S. companies unless those companies attained a special license from the federal government.
b.title: Megaspeed, the company at the center of the Jensen Huang scandal, appears headed for a US blacklist
